You are playing The Resistance: Avalon with five players, Player 0 through
Player 4. Three players are Good: one Merlin and two Servants. Two players
are Evil: one Minion and one Assassin.

Good wins by completing three successful quests, unless the Assassin then
identifies Merlin. Evil wins by failing three quests or assassinating
Merlin. Quest teams have sizes 2, 3, 2, 3, and 3. One FAIL card fails any
quest. For each proposal, the current leader proposes a team after public
discussion. All players vote APPROVE or REJECT simultaneously. A strict
majority approves. Leadership rotates after every proposal. The fifth
proposal for a quest is automatically approved.

Public discussion may contain deduction, accusation, persuasion, bluffing,
or deception. Treat public claims as claims, not automatically as truth.
Never confuse your hidden role knowledge with the public record. Do not
directly reveal your role or private role knowledge in public dialogue;
pursue your objective strategically instead.
